name: codex-ad
description: Ad creative toolkit: brainstorm 100 concepts from one product URL, then turn a chosen concept into a production-ready static ad prompt.

interface.shortDescription: Ad concepts and static ad prompts
interface.longDescription: Two skills. ad-brainstorm scrapes a single product page, analyzes its real product photography shot by shot, builds an audience map, then generates 100 ad concepts across a 10 format x 10 angle grid, with deterministic validators enforcing grid coverage, unique hooks, and image grounding. ad-maker turns marketing context into platform-aware six-slot static ad prompts, reference image lists, variants, iteration ladders, and deterministic quality scorecards.
defaultPrompt: Create a Meta feed conversion ad from this product brief.
Score this ad prompt and revise anything below 75.
